source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 12 (PDF 273-290), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nitrogen and Sulfur) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 How is nitrogen gas prepared in the laboratory? Give the balanced equation.
(Laboratory mein nitrogen gas kaise banai jati hai? Balanced equation dein.)
blocks.explanation: Ammonium nitrite ke solution ko aahista garam karne se: NH₄NO₂(aq) → N₂(g) + 2H₂O(l). 4 H aur 2 O ke liye do H₂O chahiye.

book_ref.quote: nitrogen can be generated by slowly heating a solution of ammonium nitrite

blocks.prompt:
2 What mass of nitrogen is obtained by heating 6.4 g of ammonium nitrite? (NH₄NO₂ = 64.05 g mol⁻¹, N₂ = 28.02 g mol⁻¹)
(6.4 g ammonium nitrite garam karne se kitni nitrogen milegi? (NH₄NO₂ = 64.05 g mol⁻¹, N₂ = 28.02 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: NH₄NO₂ → N₂ + 2H₂O, 1 mol se 1 mol N₂. n = 6.4 ÷ 64.05 = 0.0999 mol; N₂ ka mass = 0.0999 × 28.02 = 2.80 g.

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is NH₄NO₂(aq) → N₂(g) + 2H₂O(l).

blocks.prompt:
3 Why is the bond in the N₂ molecule nonpolar?
(N₂ molecule ka bond nonpolar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono atoms nitrogen hain, electronegativity ka farq sifar hai. Bonded electrons dono mein barabar share hote hain, is liye triple bond nonpolar hai.

book_ref.quote: This causes equal sharing of the three bonded electrons between the two atoms

blocks.prompt:
4 What does the bond enthalpy of +944 kJ mol⁻¹ of N≡N tell us about nitrogen?
(N≡N ki bond enthalpy +944 kJ mol⁻¹ nitrogen ke baare mein kya batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Triple bond bohat mazboot hai; naye bond banne se pehle ise torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye. Is liye N₂ bohat kam reactive hai.

book_ref.quote: High energy is required to break this bond to form new bonds

blocks.prompt:
5 Give two uses of nitrogen as an inert gas.
(Nitrogen ke inert gas ke taur par do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Hydrocarbons ya khaane ke tail le jaane wale jahazon par nitrogen ke blankets unhein oxygen aur nami se bachate hain. (ii) Laboratory mein jin reactions ko inert mahaul chahiye un ke liye.

book_ref.quote: it is crucial to utilize blankets of Nitrogen or any other inert gas on ships

blocks.prompt:
6 Name the industrial process for ammonia and write its equation. What is the main use of ammonia?
(Ammonia ke industrial process ka naam aur equation likhein. Ammonia ka asal istemal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haber-Bosch process: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g). Ammonia zyada tar fertilizer ke taur par istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is prepared industrially by Haber-Bosch process

blocks.prompt:
7 Show with an equation that ammonia is a Lowry-Brønsted base.
(Equation se dikhayein ke ammonia Lowry-Brønsted base hai.)
blocks.explanation: Lowry-Brønsted base proton leta hai. Ammonia acid se H⁺ le kar ammonium banati hai: NH₃(aq) + H⁺(aq) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq).

book_ref.quote: Ammonia behaves as a Lowry-Brønsted base by accepting a proton

blocks.prompt:
8 Write the equilibrium set up when ammonia dissolves in water and name the ions formed.
(Ammonia paani mein hal ho to jo equilibrium banta hai woh likhein aur ions ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: NH₃(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq), Kb = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵. Ions: ammonium (NH₄⁺) aur hydroxide (OH⁻); solution ko ammonium hydroxide kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: equilibrium is established between ammonia molecules and ammonium ions in the solution

blocks.prompt:
9 Why does the shape change when ammonia forms the ammonium ion?
(Ammonia jab ammonium ion banati hai to shakal kyun badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₃ nitrogen ke lone pair ki wajah se pyramidal hai. Jab nitrogen yeh lone pair H⁺ se bond mein laga deti hai to koi lone pair nahi bachta aur NH₄⁺ chaar barabar bonds ke saath tetrahedral ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Ammonia molecule has pyramidal shape due to lone pair of nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between NH₃ and NH₄⁺ with respect to shape and lone pair.
(NH₃ aur NH₄⁺ mein shakal aur lone pair ke lehaaz se farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: this ion adopts a tetrahedral shape

rows: Lone pair H⁺ se bond mein; koi lone pair nahi
Chaar N–H bonds, lambai aur taqat mein barabar

blocks.text: 12.2.3 Synthesis of ammonia from ammonium salts

blocks.prompt:
11 Write the balanced equation for heating ammonium chloride with calcium hydroxide. Which salt forms?
(Ammonium chloride ko calcium hydroxide ke saath garam karne ki balanced equation likhein. Kaun sa salt banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2NH₄Cl(s) + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O(l) + 2NH₃(g). Salt calcium chloride, CaCl₂, hai (sodium maujood nahi, NaCl nahi ban sakta).

book_ref.quote: There is no sodium in the reactants, so NaCl cannot form

blocks.prompt:
12 In the preparation of ammonia from an ammonium salt and a base, identify the acid and the base.
(Ammonium salt aur base se ammonia banane mein acid aur base ki nishandahi karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh acid-base reaction hai: NH₄⁺ acid hai (H⁺ deta hai) aur OH⁻ base hai (H⁺ leta hai). Ammonia gas nikalti hai aur salt aur paani bante hain.

book_ref.quote: while OH⁻ acts as a base by accepting H⁺ ions

blocks.prompt:
13 How is the ammonium ion identified in salt analysis?
(Salt analysis mein ammonium ion ki pehchan kaise hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Salt ko base ke saath garam karte hain. Agar teekhi boo wali gas nikle jo geela laal litmus neela kare (ammonia), to ammonium maujood hai.

book_ref.quote: It is commonly used to identify ammonium in salt analysis

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is the test tube clamped sloping slightly downwards towards its mouth when ammonia is prepared from a heated solid mixture?
(Garam thos mixture se ammonia banate waqt test tube ka munh thora neeche kyun rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction mein paani banta hai. Munh neeche hone se paani wapis garam sheeshe par nahi behta, warna tube toot sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: The tube should slope slightly downwards towards its mouth

blocks.prompt:
15 Why is the formula of ammonium nitrate NH₄NO₃ and not (NH₄)₂NO₃?
(Ammonium nitrate ka formula NH₄NO₃ kyun hai, (NH₄)₂NO₃ kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonium ion ka charge +1 aur nitrate ka −1 hai. Aik NH₄⁺ aik NO₃⁻ ko balance karta hai, is liye formula NH₄NO₃ hai.

book_ref.quote: Ammonium nitrate is NH₄NO₃, not (NH₄)₂NO₃

blocks.prompt:
16 What is meant by NOₓ? Name the oxides of nitrogen given in the chapter.
(NOₓ se kya muraad hai? Chapter mein diye gaye nitrogen ke oxides ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: NO aur NO₂ ko mila kar NOₓ kehte hain. Nitrogen ke oxides NO, N₂O, NO₂, N₂O₄ aur N₂O₅ hain, oxidation states +1 se +5 tak.

book_ref.quote: NO and NO₂ are collectively called as NOₓ

blocks.prompt:
17 Why is NO paramagnetic while its dimer N₂O₂ is diamagnetic?
(NO paramagnetic kyun hai jabke us ka dimer N₂O₂ diamagnetic hai?)
blocks.explanation: NO mein 11 valence electrons (5 + 6) hain, taaq (odd) tadaad, is liye aik electron akela hai: NO paramagnetic. N₂O₂ mein dono akele electrons jori bana lete hain, is liye diamagnetic.

book_ref.quote: NO has 11 valence electrons: N=O with an unpaired electron on N

blocks.prompt:
18 What is the effect of cooling and heating on the equilibrium 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄?
(Equilibrium 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄ par thanda aur garam karne ka kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thanda karne se equilibrium aage be-rang N₂O₄ ki taraf jata hai, bhoora rang halka hota hai. Garam karne se wapis bhoore NO₂ ki taraf, rang gehra hota hai.

book_ref.quote: 2NO₂ (Brown) ⇌ N₂O₄ (Colourless): Cool →, ← Heat

blocks.prompt:
19 Give two properties and two uses of nitrous oxide (N₂O).
(Nitrous oxide (N₂O) ki do properties aur do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Properties: be-rang, meethi boo wali, paani mein hal hone wali neutral gas jo jalne mein madad deti hai. Istemal: daanton ki anaesthetic (laughing gas) aur whipped ice cream ka propellant (aur NaN₃ banana).

book_ref.quote: Colourless gas, water-soluble, neutral, sweet smelling, helps in combustion

blocks.prompt:
20 Calculate the oxidation state of nitrogen in N₂O, NO₂ and N₂O₅.
(N₂O, NO₂ aur N₂O₅ mein nitrogen ki oxidation state nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen dioxide/Nitrogen peroxide, Nitrogen tetraoxide NO₂, N₂O₄

blocks.prompt:
21 What are azane and azanium? From where are these names derived?
(Azane aur azanium kya hain? Yeh naam kahan se liye gaye?)
blocks.explanation: Azane ammonia aur azanium ammonium ka IUPAC naam hai. Yeh Azote se liye gaye, nitrogen ka Greek naam jis ka matlab 'no life' hai; sodium azide (NaN₃) jaise naamon mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These names have been derived from Azote

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between natural and anthropogenic sources of NOₓ.
(NOₓ ke qudrati (natural) aur insani (anthropogenic) zariyon mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Here are the main categories of NOₓ sources

rows: Bijli: hawa ki N₂ aur O₂ se NO
Biological decay, mitti ke microorganisms, samandar

blocks.prompt:
23 What is photochemical smog? Why is it called oxidising?
(Photochemical smog kya hai? Ise oxidising kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Photochemical (Los Angeles) smog dhoop mein NOₓ aur volatile organic compounds se fiza mein banti hai. Is mein NO₂, ozone aur PANs jaise oxidants hain jo cheezon ko oxidise karte hain, is liye yeh oxidising hai.

book_ref.quote: Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) forms in the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between photochemical smog and classical smog.
(Photochemical smog aur classical smog mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Photochemical smog is becoming more common than classical smog

rows: Los Angeles smog bhi kehte hain
Dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs se banti hai
Photochemical smog se kam aam ho rahi hai

blocks.prompt:
25 Name the components of Lahore smog.
(Lahore smog ke ajza (components) ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Lahore smog mein volatile organic compounds (VOCs), NOₓ, zameeni satah ki ozone (O₃), PM2.5 zarraat, CO aur SO₂ hain.

book_ref.quote: Lahore smog consists of volatile organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
26 How does sunlight lead to the formation of ozone from NO₂? Give the equations.
(Dhoop NO₂ se ozone kaise banwati hai? Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation: Dhoop NO₂ ko torti hai: NO₂(g) → NO(g) + O(g) (hν). Oxygen atom O₂ se milta hai: O(g) + O₂(g) → O₃(g).

book_ref.quote: NOₓ and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in the sunlight

blocks.prompt:
27 What are PANs? What is the R group in peroxyacetyl nitrate?
(PANs kya hain? Peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R group kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: PANs (peroxyacyl nitrates), RC(O)OONO₂, smog mein NOₓ se banne wale photochemical oxidants hain. Peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) mein R group CH₃ hai; doosri hydrocarbon chains bhi ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: PAN is one of the members of peroxyacyl nitrates

blocks.prompt:
28 What are the roles of the hydroxyl radical and of oxygen in the formation of PAN?
(PAN banne mein hydroxyl radical aur oxygen ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydroxyl radical aldehyde se react karke acyl radical banata hai. Phir oxygen acyl radical ko peroxyacyl radical banati hai, jo NO₂ se mil kar PAN deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The aldehyde then reacts with hydroxyl radical to produce acyl radical

blocks.prompt:
29 Why are the channels of a catalytic converter coated with alumina, and which metals are dispersed on it?
(Catalytic converter ki naaliyon par alumina kyun hoti hai aur us par kaun si metals hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alumina zyada surface area deti hai. Is par Pt (platinum), Pd (palladium) aur Rh (rhodium) phailai jaati hain jo redox reactions tez karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Its inner channels have a layer of alumina to provide a high surface area

blocks.prompt:
30 Write the reduction reaction of nitric oxide in a catalytic converter and name its catalyst.
(Catalytic converter mein nitric oxide ki reduction ka reaction likhein aur catalyst ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: 2NO(g) + 2CO(g) → N₂(g) + 2CO₂(g), catalyst Pt/Rh (platinum/rhodium). NO reduce ho kar N₂ aur CO oxidise ho kar CO₂ banti hai.

book_ref.quote: ‘Rd’ is not the symbol of any element

blocks.prompt:
31 Write the oxidation reactions of carbon monoxide and of a hydrocarbon (C₂H₄) in a catalytic converter.
(Catalytic converter mein carbon monoxide aur hydrocarbon (C₂H₄) ki oxidation ke reactions likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 2CO(g) + O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) aur 2C₂H₄ + 6O₂(g) → 4CO₂(g) + 4H₂O(g), dono Pt/Rh se.

book_ref.quote: should be Rh: the catalyst is Pt/Rh

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between nitrification and denitrification with respect to the conditions and the change of nitrogen.
(Nitrification aur denitrification mein halaat aur nitrogen ki tabdeeli ke lehaaz se farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Nitrification and denitrification are the two phases of the nitrogen cycle

blocks.prompt:
33 Write the two steps of nitrification as equations.
(Nitrification ke do qadam equations ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam: 2NH₄⁺(aq) + 3O₂(aq) → 2NO₂⁻(aq) + 4H⁺(aq) + 2H₂O(l). Doosra qadam: 2NO₂⁻(aq) + O₂(aq) → 2NO₃⁻(aq).

book_ref.quote: 2NH₄¹⁺(aq) + 3O₂(aq) → 2NO₂¹⁻(aq) + 4H⁺(aq) + 2H₂O(l)

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is denitrification called a reduction of nitrogen? Give the equation.
(Denitrification ko nitrogen ki reduction kyun kehte hain? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation: 2NO₃⁻(aq) + 10e⁻ + 12H⁺(aq) → N₂(g) + 6H₂O(l). Nitrogen electrons leti hai: oxidation state NO₃⁻ mein +5 se N₂ mein 0 ho jati hai, is liye reduction hai.

book_ref.quote: 2NO₃¹⁻(aq) + 10e⁻ + 12H⁺(aq) → N₂(g) + 6H₂O(l)

blocks.prompt:
35 Why are nitrification and denitrification important?
(Nitrification aur denitrification kyun aham hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrification nitrites aur nitrates deti hai jo paude jazb karte hain, kyun ke woh N₂ seedha nahi le sakte. Denitrification N₂ wapis fiza mein bhejti hai. Dono mil kar wastewater se nitrogen nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: These two processes are also involved in the wastewater treatment to remove nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
36 Give the group, family name, electronic configuration and common oxidation states of sulfur.
(Sulfur ka group, family ka naam, electronic configuration aur aam oxidation states batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Sulfur group 16, chalcogen family mein hai. Configuration [Ne] 3s² 3p⁴ (atomic number 16). Aam oxidation states +4 aur +6.

book_ref.quote: Sulfur is a member of group 16 which is also called the Chalcogen family

blocks.prompt:
37 What is catenation? Why does sulfur show it?
(Catenation kya hai? Sulfur yeh kyun dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Catenation aik hi element ke atoms ka jur kar bare molecules aur structures banana hai. Sulfur kamzor orbital overlap ki wajah se double ki bajaye single bonds banata hai, is liye chains aur rings banata hai jaise taaj numa S₈.

book_ref.quote: it forms larger molecules and structures through a process called catenation

blocks.prompt:
38 List the oxidation states of sulfur. How are they related to its electronic configuration?
(Sulfur ki oxidation states batayein. In ka electronic configuration se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfur −2, 0, +2, +4 aur +6 dikhata hai. Figure 12.8 mein oxidation state configuration ke unpaired electrons ki tadaad se tay hoti hai jo bonding ke liye available hain.

book_ref.quote: the oxidation state is determined by the number of unpaired electrons

blocks.prompt:
39 Why does sulfur burn to SO₂ rather than SO₃ under standard conditions?
(Standard halaat mein sulfur jal kar SO₃ ki bajaye SO₂ kyun banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Standard halaat mein sulfur aur oxygen SO₂ (+4) banate hain. SO₃ (+6) ke liye zyada energy chahiye, is liye zyada temperature aur catalyst chahiye.

book_ref.quote: However, to form sulfur trioxide (SO₃) with an oxidation state of +6, high energy is required

blocks.text: 12.9 Stability of the oxidation states of sulfur

blocks.prompt:
40 What is a Frost diagram?
(Frost diagram kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Element X ka Frost diagram couple X(n)/X(0) ke liye nE° aur oxidation state (n) ka graph hai. Yeh pH = 0 aur pH = 14 par oxidation states ki nisbati stability dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: is a plot of nE⁰ vs oxidation state (n)

blocks.prompt:
41 Give the relation between ΔG° and nE° used in a Frost diagram and name the symbols.
(Frost diagram mein istemal hone wala ΔG° aur nE° ka talluq likhein aur symbols ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: −ΔG° = nFE°, ya −ΔG°/F = nE°. E° = standard reduction potential, F = Faraday constant, n = redox half reaction mein muntaqil electrons ki tadaad.

book_ref.quote: Here E⁰ is the standard reduction potential

blocks.prompt:
42 How does a Frost diagram show the stable state, a good oxidising agent and a good reducing agent?
(Frost diagram stable state, ache oxidising agent aur ache reducing agent ko kaise dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se stable state sab se neeche hoti hai (kam nE°, zyada manfi ΔG°). Zyada musbat slope wala couple acha oxidising agent, zyada manfi slope wala acha reducing agent hai.

book_ref.quote: a couple with a more negative slope is a good reducing agent

blocks.prompt:
43 For a couple X(n)/X(0) of an element X, n = 4 and E° = +0.30 V. Find nE° and ΔG°. (F = 96485 C mol⁻¹)
(Element X ke couple X(n)/X(0) ke liye n = 4 aur E° = +0.30 V. nE° aur ΔG° nikalein. (F = 96485 C mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: F is the Faraday constant and n is the number of transferred electrons

blocks.prompt:
44 Why does sulfur tarnish silver? Give the equation.
(Sulfur silver ko daagdaar kyun karta hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation: Silver ki electronegativity sulfur se kam hai, is liye sulfur oxidizing agent ban kar silver sulfide ki teh banata hai: 2Ag(s) + S(s) → Ag₂S(s).

book_ref.quote: It tarnishes Ag, Cu, and Zn by forming a coating of metal sulfide

blocks.prompt:
45 What is formed when potassium cyanide is heated with sulfur? Give one use of the product.
(Potassium cyanide ko sulfur ke saath garam karne se kya banta hai? Product ka aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: KCN(s) + S(s) → KSCN(s) (garam karne par). Thiocyanate (pseudohalide) Fe³⁺ ke analysis mein kaam aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Sulfur converts cyanide into thiocyanate which is also known as pseudohalide

blocks.prompt:
46 Write the reaction of sulfur with nitric acid. What happens to sulfur in it?
(Sulfur ka nitric acid se reaction likhein. Is mein sulfur ke saath kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: S(s) + 6HNO₃(l) → H₂SO₄(l) + 6NO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l). Sulfur 0 se +6 (H₂SO₄ mein) oxidise hota hai; nitric acid reduce ho kar NO₂ banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Sulfur can be oxidised by nitric acid to produce NO₂ and H₂SO₄

blocks.prompt:
47 How is sulfur hexafluoride formed, and why is it used in electric devices?
(Sulfur hexafluoride kaise banti hai aur bijli ke aalaat mein kyun istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfur fluorine se seedha react karta hai: S(s) + 3F₂(g) → SF₆(g). SF₆ bohat kam reactive gas hai, is liye bijli ke aalaat mein insulator gas hai.

book_ref.quote: Sulfur hexafluoride (SF₆) is a gas and is very unreactive

blocks.prompt:
48 Find the oxidation state of sulfur in S₂Cl₂ and in SCl₂ (Cl = −1).
(S₂Cl₂ aur SCl₂ mein sulfur ki oxidation state nikalein (Cl = −1).)
blocks.explanation: S₂Cl₂: 2x + 2(−1) = 0, x = +1. SCl₂: x + 2(−1) = 0, x = +2. S₂Cl₂ peela aur SCl₂ laal liquid hai.

book_ref.quote: which further reacts with Cl₂ to form SCl₂ (red liquid)

blocks.prompt:
49 How is sulfur restored to soils depleted in sulfate?
(Sulfate ki kami wali mitti mein sulfur kaise wapis laaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfur wale N/P fertilizers ya sulfur-coated fertilizers (maslan sulfur-coated urea) daal kar; gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O) bhi. Mitti ke ajza aur microbes sulfur ko hal hone wali shakal mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: sulfur can be restored in soil by applying sulfur containing N/P fertilizers

blocks.prompt:
50 Calculate the mass of each component in 250 g of gunpowder.
(250 g gunpowder mein har juz (component) ka mass nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Gunpowder 75 % KNO₃, 15 % koyla aur 10 % sulfur hai. KNO₃ = 0.75 × 250 = 187.5 g; koyla = 0.15 × 250 = 37.5 g; sulfur = 0.10 × 250 = 25.0 g.

book_ref.quote: Gun powder is a coarse blend of 75% potassium nitrate

blocks.prompt:
51 Using the burning equation of gunpowder, find the moles of gas formed from 2.0 mol of KNO₃.
(Gunpowder ke jalne ki equation se 2.0 mol KNO₃ se banne wali gas ke mol nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 10KNO₃ + 3S + 8C → 2K₂CO₃ + 3K₂SO₄ + 6CO₂ + 5N₂: 10 mol KNO₃ se 6 + 5 = 11 mol gas. 2.0 mol se: 2.0 × 11/10 = 2.2 mol gas (CO₂ + N₂).

book_ref.quote: Charcoal carbon is the main fuel, nitrate is the oxidiser

blocks.text: 12.12 Role of sulfur in the organic synthesis of drugs, dyes and fragrances

blocks.prompt:
52 Name four functional groups that contain carbon-sulfur bonds.
(Carbon-sulfur bonds wale chaar functional groups ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Thiols (mercaptans), thioethers, sulfoxides aur sulfones. Aise compounds biological, pharmaceutical aur material properties rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Carbon-Sulfur bonds are prevalent in a wide range of compounds

blocks.prompt:
53 What are sulfa drugs? Are penicillins sulfa drugs?
(Sulfa drugs kya hain? Kya penicillins sulfa drugs hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfa drugs antibacterial sulfonamides hain jin mein sulfur hai. Penicillins aur cephalosporins sulfonamides nahi; yeh beta-lactam antibiotics hain jin ke rings mein bhi sulfur hai.

book_ref.quote: Sulfa drugs (the antibacterial sulfonamides) contain sulfur

blocks.prompt:
54 How are sulfur dyes made? Name two examples.
(Sulfur dyes kaise banaye jaate hain? Do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nitro ya amino groups wale organic compounds ki thionation (sulfurization) se; in mein sulfur linkages hain aur yeh kaala, bhoora, khaki, neela aur hara rang dete hain. Misaalein: sulfur black 1, sulfur blue (aur sulfur brilliant green).

book_ref.quote: Sulfur dyes are synthesised by the process of thionation or sulfurization

blocks.prompt:
55 Give two uses of sulfur compounds as odorants or fragrances.
(Sulfur compounds ke boo ya khushboo ke taur par do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Mercaptans natural gas ko boo dete hain. (ii) Thioterpineol grapefruit ki khushboo ka aham juz hai; cis-galbanum oxathiane fragrances, sabun, shampoo aur shower gels mein lagta hai.

book_ref.quote: Mercaptans are used to give odour to natural gas

blocks.prompt:
56 Describe the structure of the sulphuric acid molecule.
(Sulphuric acid molecule ki banawat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: H₂SO₄ mein sulfur ke gird tetrahedral banawat hai, do S−O bonds (har aik OH group se) aur do S=O bonds. Sulfur +6 state mein hai.

book_ref.quote: It has tetrahedral structure with two S−O and two S=O bonds

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is SO₂ from pyrite purified in the contact process? How is arsenic oxide removed?
(Contact process mein pyrite se bani SO₂ kyun saaf ki jati hai? Arsenic oxide kaise nikala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gard, bukharat aur arsenic oxide catalyst ki karkardagi kharab karte hain. Arsenic purifier mein shelves par gelatinous Fe(OH)₃ ise jazb karta hai: As₂O₃ + 2Fe(OH)₃ → 2FeAsO₃ + 3H₂O.

book_ref.quote: In an arsenic purifier, gelatinous ferric hydroxide Fe(OH)₃

blocks.prompt:
58 Write the balanced equation for heating iron pyrite in excess air in the contact process.
(Contact process mein iron pyrite ko zyada hawa mein garam karne ki balanced equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Iron pyrite FeS₂ hai: 4FeS₂(s) + 11O₂(g) → 2Fe₂O₃(s) + 8SO₂(g). Jaanch: daayen taraf O = 6 + 16 = 22 = 11 O₂.

book_ref.quote: for iron pyrite, FeS₂, it is 4FeS₂(s) + 11O₂(g) → 2Fe₂O₃(s) + 8SO₂(g)

blocks.prompt:
59 State the conditions used in the contact tower.
(Contact tower mein istemal hone wale halaat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Saaf SO₂ aur hawa 420–450 °C tak garam karke 1–2 atm par V₂O₅ catalyst par guzari jaati hai: SO₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ SO₃, ΔH = −98.98 kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Purified SO₂ and air, preheated at 420 °C– 450 °C

blocks.prompt:
60 Calculate the heat released when 4.0 mol of SO₂ is converted into SO₃ in the contact tower (ΔH = −98.98 kJ mol⁻¹).
(Contact tower mein 4.0 mol SO₂ ko SO₃ banane mein kitni garmi nikalti hai (ΔH = −98.98 kJ mol⁻¹)?)
blocks.explanation: Nikalne wali garmi = 4.0 × 98.98 = 395.9 kJ (≈ 396 kJ); 4.0 mol ke liye ΔH = −395.9 kJ.

book_ref.quote: these gases come in contact with vanadium pentoxide (V₂O₅) catalyst

blocks.prompt:
61 Write the equations for the formation of oleum and for its reaction with water.
(Oleum banne aur us ke paani se reaction ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: SO₃ sulphuric acid mein hal hoti hai: H₂SO₄(l) + SO₃(g) → H₂S₂O₇(l) (oleum). Oleum aur paani: H₂S₂O₇(l) + H₂O(l) → 2H₂SO₄(l), jis ka concentration tay kiya ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Oleum undergoes a reaction with water to make a highly concentrated solution

blocks.prompt:
62 Why should concentrated sulphuric acid be kept in a closed bottle?
(Concentrated sulphuric acid band botal mein kyun rakhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh hygroscopic hai aur hawa se paani ke bukharat jazb karke patla ho jata hai. Yeh bohat corrosive bhi hai aur jild jalata hai, is liye ehtiyat zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Sulphuric acid is soluble in water and hygroscopic in nature

blocks.prompt:
63 Give four physical properties of sulphuric acid.
(Sulphuric acid ki chaar physical properties batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Be-rang, be-boo, garha liquid; melting point 10 °C; boiling point 290 °C; specific gravity 15 °C par 1.83 g/cm³ (molar mass 98.08 g/mol).

book_ref.quote: Table 12.5 Physical properties of Sulphuric acid

blocks.prompt:
64 Why can sulphuric acid be used as a non-aqueous protic solvent?
(Sulphuric acid non-aqueous protic solvent kyun ban sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh khud ionize hota hai: H₂SO₄ + H₂SO₄ ⇌ H₃SO₄⁺ + HSO₄⁻, K = 2.7 × 10⁻⁴. Yeh constant paani se zyada hai, is liye yeh non-aqueous protic solvent hai.

book_ref.quote: The equilibrium constant value is greater than that of water

blocks.prompt:
65 Why is HSO₄⁻ a much weaker acid than H₂SO₄?
(HSO₄⁻ H₂SO₄ se bohat kamzor acid kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli ionization H₂SO₄ + H₂O ⇌ H₃O⁺ + HSO₄⁻ ka pKa1 = −2 (taqatwar acid). Doosri, HSO₄⁻ + H₂O ⇌ H₃O⁺ + SO₄²⁻, ka pKa2 = 1.92 musbat hai, is liye HSO₄⁻ bohat kamzor acid hai.

book_ref.quote: But hydrogensulfate (HSO₄¹⁻) is a far weaker acid due to a positive pKa2 value

blocks.prompt:
66 What is the carbon snake? Write the equation.
(Carbon snake kya hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab concentrated H₂SO₄ cheeni se paani nikalta hai to kaala saurakhdaar carbon (carbon snake) ooper uthta hai: C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁(s) + H₂SO₄(l) → 12C(s) + 11H₂O(g) + H₂SO₄(aq).

book_ref.quote: a black porous carbon mass called carbon snake

blocks.prompt:
67 How is hydrogen chloride gas prepared from sodium chloride? Give the equation.
(Sodium chloride se hydrogen chloride gas kaise banti hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation: Sodium chloride ke sulphuric acid se reaction se: NaCl(s) + H₂SO₄(l) → NaHSO₄(s) + HCl(g).

book_ref.quote: Hydrochloric acid (HCl) gas, is formed when sulphuric acid reacts with sodium chloride

blocks.prompt:
68 How does the reaction of zinc with dilute sulphuric acid differ from that with concentrated sulphuric acid?
(Zinc ka halke sulphuric acid ke saath reaction concentrated acid ke reaction se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Zinc gives Zn²⁺, not Fe²⁺, and two H₂SO₄ are needed

blocks.prompt:
69 Sulphuric acid is not a typical oxidising agent, yet hot concentrated acid oxidises copper. Explain.
(Sulphuric acid aam oxidising agent nahi, phir bhi garam concentrated acid copper ko oxidise karta hai. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: SO₄²⁻ anion mustahkam aur kamzor oxidising hai. Garam concentrated acid zyada temperature, zyada H⁺ aur nascent oxygen ki wajah se darmiyana taqatwar oxidiser ban jata hai: Cu + 2H₂SO₄ → SO₂ + 2H₂O + SO₄²⁻ + Cu²⁺.

book_ref.quote: However hot concentrated sulphuric acid is a moderately strong oxidising agent

blocks.prompt:
70 Why is sulphuric acid called the king of chemicals?
(Sulphuric acid ko king of chemicals kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bohat si industries (fertilizers, metals nikalna, refining, kaghaz, explosives, paint, khurak, batteries) mein lagta hai aur is ka istemal mulk ki sanati taraqqi ki nishani hai.

book_ref.quote: its consumption is an indicator of the industrial progress of a country

blocks.prompt:
71 Name two fertilizers made with the help of sulphuric acid.
(Sulphuric acid ki madad se banne wale do fertilizers ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Single superphosphate, Ca(H₂PO₄)₂, fluorapatite Ca₅(PO₄)₃F se (phosphoric acid bhi banta hai). (ii) Ammonium sulfate, sulphuric acid aur ammonia ke reaction se.

book_ref.quote: Fluorapatite (Ca₅(PO₄)₃F) to make single superphosphate

blocks.prompt:
72 Give four industrial uses of sulphuric acid other than fertilizers.
(Fertilizers ke ilawa sulphuric acid ke chaar sanati istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Sanati processes mein gases sukhana. (ii) TNT jaise explosives ke liye nitration. (iii) Paint ke liye TiO₂ pigment banana. (iv) Lead storage batteries (aur metals nikalna, kaghaz, laboratory reagent).

book_ref.quote: It is used to dry gases in industrial processes
